text: Above the title, the device of the press: a shield under a crown in a burst of rays, with ribbons; on the lower ribbons the English words «HYDERABAD» and «DECCAN», along the right side of the shield «PUBLICATIONS»; the other words of the device are not legible in the scan. Not transcribed.

L01 and L10 are set in a larger type; L04-L08 are the two columns of the list of the treatises, written as rows (right column, then left column); L09, the eleventh treatise, is centred under them. The numbers of the list are followed by a short dash at the baseline, written ـ. Between L09 and L10 a rule with a small ornament in its middle. L13: «١٣٦٧ هـ» over a rule and «١٩٤٨ م» under it, with «سنة» at the right end of the rule; L14, at the lower left of the page: «تعداد الطبع» (the print run) with «٥٠٠» over a rule and «١٣٥٧ ف» (the year of the Fasli era) under it.

Read on the scan with the dots measured (calendar/tools/band.py): on this page a single dot is 5-7 px across and the two dots of a letter, run together, 9-12 px. L04: «للحوارزمى», the خ printed without its dot. L05: the name of the author of the fourth treatise is printed «للقابنى», with one dot (6 px) under the tooth after the alif, where the third treatise has «للقاينى» with two (9 px); «اليهود» of the third treatise is printed with its و filled in. L06: «المكاف», the word ends with the final ف, without the ى (or ئ) of المكافئ. L12: the د and the ك of «الدكن» are blotted; read الدكن. L08: a speck above the alif of «القطاع».
The item numbers: the five of the list (L06) is printed in the Indian form, a small round loop; transcribed ٥. The digits of the page are the Arabic-Indic digits (٤ in ١٩٤٨ in the Arabic form).

L01 «مقالة» in a large type with a long swash; L05 in a larger type. Between L04 and L05 a rule with an ornament in its middle, and below it, a little to the left of the middle, a small printed mark like a tooth with a curl (about 30 px wide); not transcribed. L11: «١٣٦٦ هـ» over a rule and «١٩٤٧ م» under it, with «سنة» in a smaller type at the right end of the rule; L12, at the lower right of the page: the print run «٥٠٠» over a rule and «١٣٥٦ ف» (the year of the Fasli era) under it.

L12: «تعدا. الطبع»: the second د of تعداد (so printed in full on PDF 1, L14) is missing, and a small dot (6 px) stands in its place, at the height of the baseline; transcribed as printed. L03: «تاليف», without hamza; L04: «الخوارزمى», with the dot of the خ, the final ى without dots.

The edition was printed with a separate pagination and a title page of its own dated 1366/1947 and bound with other treatises in collections dated 1367/1948 (PDF 1); de Blois, n. 2, describes two such collections, of nine and of eleven treatises, with al-Khwarizmi's first in both.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٢» at its right; at the lower left the catchword «وابتلاء», the first word of p. 3 (PDF 4); recorded here, not transcribed as lines. L01, the basmala, is centred; L05 begins with a paragraph indent. L04 ends with the edition's full stop, a large round dot at mid-height, written •.

Spacing. The edition sets the letters that do not join the next with irregular white after them: on this page the white inside a word after such a letter measures 5 to 14 px (العا قل, الصا لحين, ذ لك 13 px), and a word space 6 to 17 px (calendar/tools/gaps.py), so that the gaps do not show where a word ends. The words are divided by the sense. Where the print suggests another division: L03, the alif of اذا stands 7 px from فعل and 14 px from the ذ, so that the line reads at first sight «فاذ افعل»; L06, «والنهار ودليلا» is set «والنها رود ليلا» (13 px after the alif, 15 px after the د), and «ليلا على» with 6 px between the words.

Read as printed: L02 «مفترض»; L04 «بالمؤونة», with the hamza on the first و, «والآخرة» with the madda; L08 «الموكد» without hamza, «الاوراد», «نيسن»; L11 «فسحا», the Passover, with س; L13 «رأس» with the hamza; L14 «آى» with the madda and the final ى without dots; L15 «التورٰة», with a small raised alif in place of the alif of التوراة (so printed with the full alif in L05). L14: the two dots of the ي of «كثيرة» run into the tail of the ر; L06: those of «والايام» stand low under the line.
In the left margin beside L06, a short vertical stroke (about 25 px), outside the text block; not transcribed.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٣» at its left; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L16 ends with the edition's full stop, a large round dot (•); L17 begins with a paragraph indent.

Read as printed: L01 «ليجزيهم», with a short horizontal mark above the ي (a broken shadda?), «عما»; L02 «لنبى», the final ى without dots; L03 «سيأتى» with the hamza on the alif; L05 «اليونانين», with one ي (for اليونانيين; the dots of the ن, the ي and the final ن measured: one above, two below, one above); L10 «ورأس» with the hamza; L12 «المحزور», the Hebrew mahzor (cycle); L13 «المعبرة» (Hebrew ‘ibbur, the intercalated year) and «الزايد» with ي for the hamza; L14 «اذار الاخير», the second Adar; L15 «رؤس». The spacing after letters that do not join is as irregular as on p. 2 (PDF 3); the words are divided by the sense.
L16: the first letter of «فضت» is a filled loop with a dot (9 px) standing 17 px above it; no letter of L15 above it has a dot below; read ف.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٤» at its right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. At the foot, centred, «(١)», with no mark in the text that refers to it (a mark of the printer's sheet?), and at the lower left the catchword «والسنة», the first word of p. 5 (PDF 6); recorded here, not transcribed as lines. L03 and L11 begin with a paragraph indent; L02 and L10 end with the edition's full stop (•); L08 and L09 have the Arabic comma «،».

The numbers of days are printed in Arabic-Indic digits, set between dashes; the dashes vary in length (about 15 to 40 px) and some are broken in two; all are written ـ. L11: the dash after «٢٩» carries a dot above it; not transcribed.

The names of the months, as printed: نيسن, اير, سيوان, تمز, اوب, ايلل, تشرى, فرحشوان (L07) and مرحشوان (L09, L11), كسليو, طبيث, شباط, اذار. L07: the first letter of «فرحشوان» is a loop with a dot well above it, as in «فضت» (p. 3, PDF 4, L16); under the two teeth after the ط of «وطبيث» one dot each, above the last its three dots; read طبيث. L12 «واذا كان السنة», كان without the ت of the feminine, as printed; L14 «من الزياد».

Checked: the regular year (تقدير, a full and a defective month in turn: Nisan 30, Iyyar 29, Sivan 30, Tammuz 29, Av 30, Elul 29, Tishri 30, Marheshvan 29, Kislev 30, Tevet 29, Shevat 30, Adar 29) has 354 days; the full year, with Marheshvan and Kislev of 30, 355; the defective year, with both of 29, 353; the intercalated year has Adar I of 30 and Adar II of 29 days, 30 days more.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٥» at its left; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L05 begins with a paragraph indent; L08 does not. L04 ends with the edition's full stop (•); after «جزء» in L10 no stop is printed, only a small mark above the hamza.

The numbers are printed in Arabic-Indic digits between dashes (written ـ, as on p. 4, PDF 5). L16: the last digit of «١٠٩» is a small loop (13 px) set high, without the stem of the nine, so that it stands at the height of the tops of the other digits; read ٩. L13: «ولا فى» is set close, «ولافى»; L15: «ويكون مرحشوان» is set without a space; the words are divided by the sense.
Read as printed: L02 «آخر الساعة», with the madda; L05 «ثلثمائة»; L06 «وثمان»; L07 «شهرا فايامها» set «شهر افايامها»; L10 «عبور», the Hebrew ‘ibbur; L11 «يمضى».

Checked: twelve months of 29 days 12 hours 793 parts make 354 days 8 hours 876 parts, as L05-L06 print; thirteen make 383 days 21 hours 589 parts (L07 prints 489); the nineteen-year cycle of 235 months, 12 x 354d 8h 876p + 7 x 383d 21h 589p, makes 6939 days 16 hours 595 parts (L09-L10 print 6939 days 16 hours 494 parts). The day of L11-L19 begins at nightfall, so that «the ninth hour of Friday» is the twenty-first hour of the Jewish day (from 20 hours to 21 hours after nightfall) and «the first hour of the night of Friday» its first hour: the limits of L11 and L14 are Friday 20h 491p and Friday 0h 408p of the later reckoning, both limits of the four gates of the standard calendar (calendar/checks/gates.py). The 204 of L18 is Friday 9h 204p, the limit of the gates for a common year followed by a leap year (AK15-CN013).

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٦» at its right, with a small mark (7 x 11 px) above the digit; at the lower left the catchword «يوم», the first word of p. 7 (PDF 8); recorded here, not transcribed as lines. Below L19, under «بعد», a short mark (13 x 9 px) stands 58 px below the baseline; not transcribed. L09 ends with the edition's full stop (•, 24 x 26 px); no line of the page begins with a paragraph indent.

The numbers are printed in Arabic-Indic digits. Dashes (written ـ, as on p. 4, PDF 5): on both sides of the number in L01 and L06, after it only in L12, L17 and L19, none in L02, L08 and L14. L02: after «تشرى» the digits «١١٢» are followed by eight dots of the size, shape and spacing of the zeros of the page (13-14 x 15-16 px, a diamond, every 29 px; the zero of «٢٠٤» in L06 measures 13 x 16 px, the full stop of L09 24 x 26 px), so that the print shows the figure ١١٢٠٠٠٠٠٠٠٠; it is transcribed as printed.

Read as printed: L01 and L03 «الحادى عشرة», the masculine ordinal with the feminine عشرة (for الساعة الحادية عشرة); L11 and L13 «الثلاثاء», L15 «الثلثاء»; L07, L12 and L16 «كالتقدير», L14 «بالتقدير», the first letter with one dot below. L08: under the first letter of «يعد» a blob of 13 x 9 px with a notch below and a thin tail (18 px in all), the size of a pair of dots (the single dot under the ب of «بعد» in L03 measures 8 x 9 px); read ي. L05 and L07: in «وولد القمر» and «فان ولد القمر» the alif of القمر stands 11 px and 2 px from the د and 11 px from the ل, so that the print reads at first sight «ولدا لقمر»; the words are divided by the sense. L18: the upper end of the ل of «ولد» is broken off (a piece of 8 x 7 px); read ولد.

Checked against the four gates of the standard calendar (calendar/checks/gates.py, gates.out.txt), with the hours counted as on p. 5 (PDF 6): «the tenth hour of the night of Thursday» is Thursday 9h-10h of the later reckoning and «the seventh hour of the day of Tuesday» Tuesday 18h-19h. L05-L09, a common year: a molad before Thursday 9h 204p gives Thursday with Marheshvan and Kislev regular, after it Thursday with both full (the gates: 354 and 355 days). L10-L12, a leap year: before Tuesday 18h, Tuesday, regular (384 days). L12-L16, a common year: before Tuesday 9h 204p, Tuesday, regular; after it, Thursday, regular (354 days). L16-L19, a leap year: before Sunday 20h 491p, Monday, deficient (383 days); after it the sentence continues on p. 7 (PDF 8). These limits agree with the gates. For L01-L05, a leap year with the first of Tishri on Thursday, see AK15-CN015 and AK15-CN016.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٧» at its left; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L01 continues the catchword «يوم» of p. 6 (PDF 7). L10 is a short line ending with the edition's full stop (•); L11 begins with a paragraph indent (about 120 px). Below L19 a rule across the text block, and under it the footnote N01, set in a smaller type at the right; no catchword.

The numbers are printed in Arabic-Indic digits; dashes (written ـ, as on p. 4, PDF 5) stand on both sides of the number in L08, L11 (twice), L12 and L14, after it only in L05; the number of L02 and «٣٧٩١» in L12 have none. L14: between the ٠ and the ٨ of «٤٠٨٢» a raised dot (8 x 7 px) stands at the height of the tops of the digits; not transcribed. L11: the fives of «٣٦٥» and «٥» are printed as fives.

The positions of L16-L19 are written in abjad letters, a group for the sign and a group for the degree, set apart and between dashes: «ه كو», 5 signs 26 degrees, that is 176°; some positions add groups for minutes and seconds, as L19 «ط كو م يو» (9 signs 26 degrees 40 minutes 16 seconds) and «ى كب ط», and as the list of p. 8 (PDF 9) does throughout. L16 «ا ه» (12 px apart) and L17 «و ه» (15 px), as «ه كو» (8 px); since «اه» and «وه» are not abjad numbers (the larger value is written first), they are written as two groups. L17: after «المريخ» the letters ا and و (8 px apart) stand without a dash where the position of Mars is expected; they are divided as the groups «ا و», like «ا ه» and «و ه»; the print may also be read «او», «or». L17 «عطارد (١)»: the footnote N01, «a blank in the original», says that the manuscript has no position for Mercury.

Read as printed: in L02 «تامين», L05 and L08 «يمضى من», L09 «الرابعة من» and L10 «مرحشوان» the م is a filled oval (about 10 x 15 px) standing apart from the next letter, its joining stroke not printed, so that it looks like a large dot; read م (the full stop measures 24 x 26 px). L07 «وكسليو»; L08 «ميلاد القمر», for the molad; L13 «ومأية» with the hamza on the alif, «آدم» with the madda; L14 «معبرة», with one dot under the third letter (6 x 7 px), and «التوراة» with the full alif; L15 «الآن» with the madda; L18 «لبناء».

Checked against the four gates of the standard calendar (calendar/checks/gates.py), with the hours counted as on p. 5 (PDF 6). L01-L02 with p. 6 (PDF 7) L18-L19, a leap year: a molad from Sunday 20h 491p to the limit of Monday gives Monday with the year complete (385 days). L02-L04, a common year: before Sunday 9h 204p, Monday, deficient (353 days); L04-L07: after it, to the limit of Monday, Monday, complete (355 days), see AK15-CN020. L07-L10, a common year after a leap year: a molad after 589 parts of the fourth hour of the day of Monday (Monday 15h 589p, see AK15-CN021) gives Tuesday with the year regular (354 days), the rule later called BeTUTaKPaT: with a molad from Monday 15h 589p the molad of the leap year before lies 5 days 21 hours 589 parts earlier, on Tuesday at 18h or later, so that its first of Tishri was Thursday, and a first of Tishri on Monday would leave it 382 days.

Checked: the solar year of L11-L12, 365 days and 5 3791/4104 hours, is the nineteen-year cycle divided by 19: 6939d 16h 595p (p. 5, PDF 6, L09-L10, with AK15-CN011) / 19 = 365d 5h 997 12/19 parts, and 997 12/19 parts = 18955/20520 hour = 3791/4104 hour, as de Blois states for this section.

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٨» at its right; at the lower left the catchword «وسبعون», the first word of p. 9 (PDF 10); recorded here, not transcribed as lines. L06 is a short line ending with the edition's full stop (•), as L18 ends with one; L07 and L19 begin with a paragraph indent (about 130 and 115 px).

L01-L06 continue the positions of p. 7 (PDF 8) in abjad letters, divided into groups by spaces and dashes as printed: L01-L02 the end of the list for the building of the Temple (Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, the head), L02-L06 the list for the beginning of the years of Dhū l-Qarnayn: the mean sun «و ـ يح لا لح» (6 signs 18 degrees 31 minutes 38 seconds), the moon «د و مه مط», the apogee of the moon «ر كو ير يط», Saturn «ح ح ـ كد و», Jupiter «ج يب نب لح لج», Mars «ح يب يد مو», Venus «ب ا ـ كب ج», Mercury «ر ى الح», the head «د كج ما كز» (4 signs 23 degrees 41 minutes 27 seconds). These positions have up to five groups, sign, degrees, minutes, seconds and further places, as the procedure of L07-L18 provides. L03 «و مه» and L04 «كد و» are written as two groups as on p. 7 (PDF 8). L02 «اط»: an alif and a ط, set touching; L04 «ير»: under the head of the ر a blob of 12 x 9 px with a notch below, a pair of dots, so that the head is the tooth of a ي (the first ر of the line has no dots); L06 «ر»: no dot above.

Read as printed: L08 «فليأخد», the last letter without a dot; L08 «يلقى ما», L09 «اجتمع من»: the م is a filled oval standing apart from the next letter, as on p. 7 (PDF 8); read م. L09 «تسعة عشر سنة» beside «تسع عشرة سنة»; L10 «المحزور»; L15 «فدقايق» and L17 «والدقايق» with ي for the hamza; L16 «نستخرج», the first letter with one dot above (8 x 9 px); L18 «نسبت», the first letter with one dot above (9 x 9 px) and one dot under the third (ب); L19 «لخمسة», with the ligature of ل and خ as in «الخميس» (p. 6, PDF 7), «وثلثين», «وتسعمائة».

Checked: L08-L09 add 9 to the completed years of Dhū l-Qarnayn and cast out nineteens to find the years of the current cycle; this agrees with an interval of 3448 years between the creation of Adam and the beginning of the era, since 3448 = 19 x 181 + 9 (see AK15-CN022 on p. 7, PDF 8).

The running head «استخراج تاريخ اليهود للخوارزمى» stands at the head of the page, the page number «٩» at its left; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L01 continues the catchword «وسبعون» of p. 8 (PDF 9). L03 and L12 are short lines ending with the edition's full stop (•); L04 is a heading in a larger type, centred; L05 begins with a paragraph indent; L13 and L14, the explicit, are centred. Below L14 the rest of the page is blank; at the foot, centred, «(١)», with no mark in the text that refers to it, as at the foot of p. 4 (PDF 5); recorded here, not transcribed as a line. L04: under the line between «و» and «الاستقبال» a dot of 10 x 7 px that belongs to no letter; not transcribed.

Read as printed: L01 «وثلثمائة واحد وخمسون», without و before واحد; L02 «واربعمائة»; L03 «وسبع مائة», «وثلثون»; L08 «يوما», the first letter with two dots below; L10 «وتسع مأية» with the hamza on the alif; L14 «والحمد لله», set with the ligature of لله, and «وصلوته» with و for the alif.

Checked: the base of days of p. 8 (PDF 9) L19 and L01 here, 35,975,351 days, is 5184 nineteen-year cycles of 6939d 16h 595p: 5184 x 6939 days + 5184 x 16 hours (3456 days) + 5184 x 595 parts (119 days) = 35,975,351 days, the least number of cycles that makes whole days (16h 595p = 17875 parts, and 25920 / 5 = 5184). The revolutions of the sun of L01-L02, 98,496, are the years of these cycles (5184 x 19), and 35,975,351 / 98,496 = 365.24682 days, the solar year of p. 7 (PDF 8) L11-L12. The cycles hold 5184 x 235 = 1,218,240 months, and 35,975,351 / 1,218,240 = 29.530594 days, the month of 29d 12h 793p. L06-L11: 25,920 is the number of parts in a day (24 x 1080) and 1080 the number in an hour, as de Blois describes this section (calendar/checks/constants.py).
